parameters.query:
WITH analysis_run AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    tender_id,
    tender_number,
    tender_external_id,
    tender_meta
  FROM tender_analysis_runs
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
),
field_results AS (
  SELECT
    field_index,
    field_key,
    status,
    value_text,
    confidence,
    requires_human_review,
    result_json
  FROM tender_analysis_field_results
  WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
),
documents AS (
  SELECT
    id AS document_id,
    document_index,
    file_name,
    display_name,
    file_extension
  FROM tender_analysis_documents
  WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
),
facts AS (
  SELECT
    id AS fact_id,
    field_key,
    document_id,
    analysis_unit_id,
    validator_verdict,
    evidence
  FROM tender_analysis_facts
  WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
),
units AS (
  SELECT
    document_id,
    analysis_unit_id,
    source_pages,
    ai_segments,
    provenance
  FROM tender_analysis_units
  WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'snapshot_version', 'tender_report_snapshot_v2',
  'analysis_run_id', $1::uuid,
  'analysis_run', COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'status', status,
        'tender_id', tender_id,
        'tender_number', tender_number,
        'tender_external_id', tender_external_id,
        'tender_meta', tender_meta
      )
      FROM analysis_run
    ),
    'null'::jsonb
  ),
  'field_results', COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'field_index', field_index,
          'field_key', field_key,
          'status', status,
          'value_text', value_text,
          'confidence', confidence,
          'requires_human_review', requires_human_review,
          'result_json', result_json
        )
        ORDER BY field_index
      )
      FROM field_results
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ),
  'source_index', jsonb_build_object(
    'documents', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(documents) ORDER BY document_index) FROM documents),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'facts', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(facts) ORDER BY fact_id) FROM facts),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'units', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(units) ORDER BY analysis_unit_id) FROM units),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  )
) AS report_snapshot;
